order: vendor data order: ascending index (the order of the vendor endpoint CSV files); stable between requests and releases of the same data
note: The vendor parameter map: for every endpoint parameter of the vendor CSVs, the HEB-001 column word 0xSDVV (S = DSP-select flag, D = differentiator, VV = vector id), tag V. Static, read-only data. Vector ids are PER DSP and the DSP is chosen by the vendor's channel lookup, not by this table; use GET /v1/catalog/vectors for (dsp, vector) meanings. Values are verbatim vendor text (min/max/default/granularity are strings, NA where the vendor has none); hex columns are lower-cased. Rows of file Box.txt (endpoint 'None') have a different vendor column layout, so granularity/access/heb001_word hold shifted values there: treat them as unreliable. Pagination: limit 1..500 (default 100), offset 0.., total is the number of rows matching the filters, next_offset is null on the last page.
